selection_rule: rows where Extension == ".jpg" AND exactly one of the species count columns is non-empty. Blank count cells are treated as "not that species", not as a confirmed zero. Rows tagged with more than one species were excluded (see excluded_multi_species).
naming_rule: <Reserve>_<BaitStation>_<deployment>_<original filename>, whitespace stripped from each path component; needed because 810 of the original filenames collide across reserves.
